name: Darwin Gödel Machine
description: Self-improving coding-agent framework. Its evolving artifact is an agent code bundle, evaluated on coding episodes, rather than a universal single-file task solution.
limitations: The source revision is registered; no Arena native runner or evaluation adapter is implemented.
An agent-bundle and coding-episode evaluation protocol is required before native DGM comparisons.
Registration does not make DGM compatible with all task-library problems.
